setup.command: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3-dev build-essential && python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt && (cd frontend && pnpm install)

check.command: (cd backend && ../backend/.venv/bin/python3 -c "import app.main") && (cd frontend && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit)
